label: Life-Story Chapters
description: The narrative arc a person tells about their life — a few chapters that together form the story, deliberately quarreling with the indexical checklist's refusal to narrativize.

regions.label: High Point
regions.oneLine: a high point in your life — a scene or season when things were at their best

regions.label: Low Point
regions.oneLine: a low point — the hardest stretch you've come through

regions.label: Turning Point
regions.oneLine: a turning point — a moment or decision after which things were different

regions.label: Earliest Memory
regions.oneLine: your earliest memory — the first scene you can still see

regions.label: Future Script
regions.oneLine: the chapter you haven't written yet — how you imagine the next part going
